name: Circle of Willis
summary: Анастомотический круг основания мозга: ICA, ACA, AComA, PCA, PComA, basilar.

name: MCA segments M1-M4
summary: M1 sphenoidal, M2 insular, M3 opercular, M4 cortical.

name: Internal capsule
summary: Anterior limb, genu, posterior limb (corticospinal), retrolenticular, sublenticular.

name: Basal cisterns
summary: Interpeduncular, prepontine, premedullary, ambient, quadrigeminal, chiasmatic, carotid, crural.

name: Brainstem cranial nerve nuclei
summary: Mid: III, IV. Pons: V, VI, VII, VIII. Medulla: IX, X, XI, XII.

name: Pterional approach
summary: Frontotemporal skin → temporalis → bone flap incl. sphenoid wing drilling → dural opening → sylvian split.

name: Subarachnoid hemorrhage
summary: Aneurysmal vs traumatic vs perimesencephalic; complications: rebleed, vasospasm, hydrocephalus, hyponatremia.

name: Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype
summary: WHO 2021 grade 4 IDH-wt astrocytoma; MGMT methylation predicts TMZ response.
